object.script:
-- Up/Down Counter local trainCounter = {value = 4, prev = 0} local indepCounter = {value = 2, prev = 0} local function stepCounter(state, dir, step, minVal, maxVal) if dir ~= state.prev then state.value = math.max( minVal, math.min(maxVal, state.value + dir * step) ) end state.prev = dir return state.value end
-- Consumption Rate Function local TPU = 1 local function Consumption() local buf, sum, prev = {}, 0, nil return function(v) if not prev then prev = v return 0 end local d = prev - v prev = v if #buf == TPU then sum = sum - buf[1] table.remove(buf, 1) end buf[#buf + 1] = d sum = sum + d return sum / #buf * 60 end end
local consBLCalc = Consumption() local consETCalc = Consumption()
-- Pressure Stabilizator Function local function pressureStab(isActive, currentValve, targetPressure, currentRate) if not isActive then return 0 end local err = targetPressure - currentRate if math.abs(err) < 0.001 then return currentValve end currentValve = currentValve + err * 0.02 return math.max(0, math.min(1, currentValve)) end
local v = {0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0} -- Valve 1..9 local z1, z2, consBL, consET, brakeForce = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 local compressor = false local detectEmergencyBrake = false
function onTick() chargingPressMT = property.getNumber("Main Tank Charging Pressure") chargingPressET = property.getNumber("Equalizing Tank Charging Pressure") chargingOverpressET = property.getNumber("Equalizing Tank Charging Overpressure") chargingPressST = property.getNumber("Supply Tank Charging Pressure") chargingPressBC = property.getNumber("Brake Cylinder Charging Pressure") airDistrSens = property.getNumber("Air Distributor Sensitivity (atm/s)") brakeForceMult = property.getNumber("Brake Force Multiplier")
prMT = input.getNumber(1) prET = input.getNumber(2) prBL = input.getNumber(3) prST = input.getNumber(4) prBC = input.getNumber(5) seatAD = input.getNumber(6) seatWS = input.getNumber(7)
toggleCompressor = input.getBool(1) emergencyBrakeRequest = input.getBool(2)
consBL = consBLCalc(prBL) consET = consETCalc(prET)
if consBL > 0.45 then detectEmergencyBrake = true else detectEmergencyBrake = false end
trainBrakePos = stepCounter(trainCounter, -seatWS, 1, 1, 7) indepBrakePos = stepCounter(indepCounter, -seatAD, 1, 1, 6)
if not toggleCompressor then compressor = false elseif prMT >= chargingPressMT then compressor = false elseif prMT <= chargingPressMT * 0.95 then compressor = true end
-- Train Brake if not (emergencyBrakeRequest or detectEmergencyBrake) then -- I - Release and Charging if trainBrakePos == 1 then if z1 == 0 then if prBL < chargingOverpressET * 1.2 then v[1] = (chargingOverpressET * 1.5 - prBL) / (chargingOverpressET / 2) else v[1] = 0 end
v[5] = 0
if (prBL >= chargingOverpressET * 1.2) and (prET >= chargingOverpressET * 1.15) then z1 = 1 end elseif z1 == 1 then v[1] = 0 v[5] = pressureStab(true, v[5], 0.01, consBL) if prBL <= chargingOverpressET then z1 = 2 end else v[1] = 0 v[5] = 0 end
if z2 == 0 then v[2] = 0.25 v[4] = 0 if prET >= chargingOverpressET * 1.15 then z2 = 1 end elseif z2 == 1 then v[2] = 0 v[4] = pressureStab(true, v[4], 0.01, consET) if prET <= chargingOverpressET then z2 = 2 end else v[2] = 0 v[4] = 0 end
v[3] = 0
trainPivotPos = 0.2
-- II - Train Drive and Elimination of Overpressure elseif trainBrakePos == 2 then if prBL > chargingPressET + 0.15 then v[4] = pressureStab(true, v[4], 0.003, consBL) v[2] = 0 elseif (prBL > chargingPressET - 0.05) and (prBL < chargingPressET + 0.15) then v[4] = 0 v[2] = 0 elseif prBL < chargingPressET - 0.05 then v[4] = 0 v[2] = 0.185 end
v[1] = 0 v[3] = 1 v[5] = 0
trainPivotPos = 0.1
z1, z2 = 0, 0
-- III - Overlap without feeding elseif trainBrakePos == 3 then v[1] = 0 v[2] = 0 v[3] = 0 v[4] = 0 v[5] = 0
trainPivotPos = 0
z1, z2 = 0, 0
-- IV - Overlap with feeding elseif trainBrakePos == 4 then v[2] = 0 v[3] = 0 v[4] = 0
if prBL > prET then v[1] = 0 v[5] = pressureStab(true, v[5], 0.01, consBL) elseif prBL < prET then v[1] = 0.075 v[5] = 0 end
trainPivotPos = -0.15
-- Va - Low-speed Service Braking elseif trainBrakePos == 5 then v[1] = 0 v[2] = 0 v[3] = 0 v[4] = pressureStab(true, v[5], 0.04, consET) v[5] = pressureStab(true, v[5], 0.04, consBL)
trainPivotPos = -0.35
-- V - Service Braking elseif trainBrakePos == 6 then v[1] = 0 v[2] = 0 v[3] = 0 v[4] = pressureStab(true, v[5], 0.15, consET) v[5] = pressureStab(true, v[5], 0.15, consBL)
trainPivotPos = -0.45
-- VI - Emergency Brake elseif trainBrakePos == 7 then v[1] = 0 v[2] = 0 v[3] = 0 v[4] = pressureStab(true, v[5], 0.6, consET) v[5] = pressureStab(true, v[5], 0.6, consBL)
trainPivotPos = -0.7 end else v[1] = 0 v[2] = 0 v[3] = 0 v[4] = pressureStab(true, v[5], 0.6, consET) v[5] = pressureStab(true, v[5], 0.6, consBL)
trainBrakePos = 7 trainCounter.value = 7 trainPivotPos = -0.7 end
-- Air Destributor if consBL < -0.04 then if prST > chargingPressST then v[6] = 0 elseif prST < chargingPressST then v[6] = 1 end v[7] = 0 v[8] = 0.5 elseif consBL < airDistrSens then if prST > chargingPressST then v[6] = 0 elseif prST < chargingPressST and prBL > prST then v[6] = 1 end v[7] = 0 v[8] = 0 elseif consBL > airDistrSens then v[6] = 0 if prBC < chargingPressBC then v[7] = ((prST * 1.07) - prBL) / 7 else v[7] = 0 end v[8] = 0 end
-- Independent Brake if indepBrakePos == 1 and seatAD ~= 1 then indepBrakePos = 2 indepCounter.value = 2 end
-- I - Release if indepBrakePos == 1 then v[9] = 0 v[8] = 0.5
indepPivotPos = 0.2
-- II - Train Drive elseif indepBrakePos == 2 then v[9] = 0
indepPivotPos = 0
-- III - First Brake Position elseif indepBrakePos == 3 then if prBC < 1.15 then v[9] = 0.4 v[8] = 0 else v[9] = 0 v[8] = 0.25 end
indepPivotPos = -0.2
-- IV - Second Brake Position elseif indepBrakePos == 4 then if prBC < 1.85 then v[9] = 0.4 v[8] = 0 else v[9] = 0 v[8] = 0.25 end
indepPivotPos = -0.3
-- V - Third Brake Position elseif indepBrakePos == 5 then if prBC < 2.85 then v[9] = 0.4 v[8] = 0 else v[9] = 0 v[8] = 0.25 end
indepPivotPos = -0.4
-- VI - Fourth Brake Position elseif indepBrakePos == 6 then if prBC < 3.9 then v[9] = 0.4 v[8] = 0 else v[9] = 0 v[8] = 0.25 end
indepPivotPos = -0.5 end
brakeForce = (prBC / chargingPressBC) * brakeForceMult
output.setNumber(1, trainBrakePos) output.setNumber(2, indepBrakePos) output.setNumber(3, v[1]) output.setNumber(4, v[2]) output.setNumber(5, v[3]) output.setNumber(6, v[4]) output.setNumber(7, v[5]) output.setNumber(8, v[6]) output.setNumber(9, v[7]) output.setNumber(10, v[8]) output.setNumber(11, v[9]) output.setNumber(12, brakeForce) output.setNumber(13, trainPivotPos) output.setNumber(14, indepPivotPos) output.setNumber(31, consET) output.setNumber(32, consBL)
output.setBool(32, compressor) end

object.script:
s,i,o,p,m = self,input,output,property,math pgn,pgb,gn,gb,sn,sb = p.getNumber,p.getBool,i.getNumber,i.getBool,o.setNumber,o.setBool abs = m.abs
rpsMin = m.max(pgn("RPS at throttle 0"), 2.1) rpsMax = m.max(pgn("RPS at throttle 1"), rpsMin) mix = pgb("Mixture control") stoP = pgn("Stoichiometry") afrP = pgn("Air-to-Fuel ratio") prot = pgn("Overheat protection") mode = pgb("RPS control") opt = pgb("Optimal mixture at high throttle") auto = not pgb("Autostart if engine stalls")
heat,start,stall,cyl = false,false,false,false t1,t2 = 0,0 rpsOld,stoT,afrT,floS,fuelM = 0,0,0,0,0.0000001
delay = {} for i = 1,5 do delay[i] = {0.0000001, 0.0000001} end
function clamp(x,min,max) return m.max(m.min(x,m.max(max,min)),m.min(min,max)) end
function lerp(min,max,t) local t = clamp(t,0,1) return min*(1-t)+max*t end
function pid(p,i,d) return{p=p,i=i,d=d,error=0,diff=0,integral=0, run=function(s,sp,pv,min,max,maxI,mult) local maxI,mult = maxI or max,mult or 1 local error,diff,out error = sp-pv diff = error-s.error s.error = error out = error*s.p*mult+s.integral+diff*s.d*mult if out > min and out < max then s.integral = clamp(s.integral+error*s.i*mult,min,maxI) end return clamp(error*s.p*mult+s.integral+diff*s.d*mult,min,max) end } end
pidEngine = pid(0.1, 0.002, 0)
function onTick() air = gn(1) fuel = gn(2) temp = gn(3) rps = gn(4) con = gn(5) dyn = gn(6) onPulse = gn(7) > 0 and not on on = gn(7) > 0
rpsSp = mode and clamp(con,2.1,60) or lerp(rpsMin, rpsMax, con)
if prot == 0 then rpsSp = lerp(rpsSp, 2.1, (temp-105)/10) elseif prot == 1 then if temp > 110 then heat = true elseif temp < 100 then heat = false end end if not heat and on and rps >= 2 then if air == 0 and fuel == 0 and temp == 0 then cyl = true afr = (dyn >= 12.6 and dyn <= 15) and dyn or afrP airM = pidEngine:run(rpsSp, rps, 0, 1) fuelM = airM*6.88/afr afrT = afr stoT = 0 else cyl = false flo = m.min(fuel/fuelM,0.1) floS = floS+clamp(flo-floS,-0.001,0.001) thr = pidEngine:run(rpsSp, rps, 0, 1, m.max(fuelM,0.1), 0.0015/(floS+0.0015)) air = m.max(air,0.0000001) temp = clamp(temp,0,100) if mix then afr = (dyn >= 12.6 and dyn <= 15) and dyn or afrP sto = (temp+(1400-100*afr))/(3*temp+200) else sto = (dyn >= 0.1 and dyn <= 1) and dyn or stoP end stoOpt = opt and 0.5 or sto airD,fuelD = delay[5][1],delay[5][2]
airM = clamp(-(1000000*thr*fuel*airD*((3*sto-1)*temp+(200*sto-1400)))/(100000000*air*fuelD),0.0001,1) fuelM = clamp(thr,0.0000001,clamp(-(100000000*air*fuelD)/(1000000*fuel*airD*((3*stoOpt-1)*temp+(200*stoOpt-1400))),0.0001,1))
afrT = clamp(air/m.max(fuel,0.0000001),0,99) stoT = clamp((temp+(1400-100*afrT))/(3*temp+200),-1,1) end else airM,fuelM,afrT,stoT = 0.0000001,0.0000001,0,0 pidEngine:run(0,0,0,0,0,0) end
if rpsOld >= 2 and rps < 2 then stall = true end if auto or onPulse then stall = false end if rps >= 2 then t1,t2 = 0,m.min(t2+1,30) else t1,t2 = m.min(t1+1,60),0 end if on and not stall and t2 < 30 and t1 >= 60 and not heat then start = true elseif not on or heat or t2 >= 30 then start = false end
rpsOld=rps
for i = 5,2,-1 do delay[i] = delay[i-1] end delay[1] = {airM, fuelM}
sn(1, airM) sn(2, fuelM) sn(3, rps) sn(4, gn(3)) sn(5, stoT) sn(6, afrT) sn(7, fuel*60)
sb(1, start) sb(2, cyl) end
